location: exactly one fenced code block with info string `json g3-params` inside data/f5/G3_PREREGISTRATION.md
notes: Unknown keys are echoed into the results JSON and never consulted.
loco.max_ciks_per_fold is REQUIRED and nullable (int|null): null is the explicit 'every training member of the selected folds', and an ABSENT key is a refusal, not a silent 'no cap' (red-team NF-20).
No value here is a default: the runner refuses without the ratified document.
F5_PLAN §3's defaults are the SELFTEST's values only.
embedding.rank_transform_components applies to the PIT-ranked spec arms only; the raw_levels secondary arm always carries the untransformed PCA projection.
embedding.pca_k > 0 with no usable `emb` column in the analysis frame is a REFUSAL, as is any fold realizing fewer than pca_k components.

fold_sensitivity.train_window_quarters lists ROLLING training-window arms (decision 4, owner 2026-09-11). They are reported beside the expanding-window primary and are never selected in place of it; [] runs none.

scorecard.* pins the per-company historical scorecard (decision 3, pre-registration §14): the primary arm's deduplicated test rows, a within-test-quarter tercile call, a sign-match outcome, two zero-text comparators, and Wilson 95% intervals. Hit rates are DESCRIPTIVE; the inference is the margin ladder.

scorecard.tie_rule = average_rank_straddle_no_call: percentiles come from average ranks, and a tie group whose members would fall on both sides of a tercile boundary is 'no call' in full, counted as n_tied_no_call. Ties are common in size_only (a one-feature fit is a step function), so a tie-break by filing order would be a measurement artifact in the headline comparator.
scorecard pages below scorecard.min_calls_for_company_hit_rate show ROWS ONLY: no hit rate, no numerator and no interval (§14).

gld.exclude_from_analysis removes every `is_gld` row from the analysis frame before folds, dedup and every fit, in every arm (decision 2, owner 2026-09-11); a frame with no is_gld column is a REFUSAL. gld.included_sensitivity_arm re-runs the primary spec once WITH those rows, beside the primary, never in place of it.

columns.exploratory_novelty_seq joins the exploratory block only -- never the confirmatory block and never the scorecard. Columns absent from the frame are skipped and counted (exploratory_novelty_seq_missing); that is a diagnostic, not a refusal, because the family-A rebuild lands separately.
families.novelty_sequential_exploratory turns the sequential-prior novelty feature on as an EXPLORATORY row (decision 23); it never enters the headline.
